You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find corner markers: cells whose count equals frame corner color appearing 4 times at extremes
    # corner markers: value != bg occurring exactly 4 times, forming rectangle corners
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    cands=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if c==4 and v!=bg]
    assert len(cands)==1, (cands, cnt)
    mv=cands[0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==mv]
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    F=[[I[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    hF=len(F); wF=len(F[0])
    O=[[bg]*wF for _ in range(hF)]
    O[0][0]=O[0][wF-1]=O[hF-1][0]=O[hF-1][wF-1]=mv
    # existing bars: connected components of non-bg non-corner colors, size>=2 -> bars
    seen=set(); bars=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg and I[i][j]!=mv and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]; seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and (na,nb) not in seen and I[na][nb]!=bg and I[na][nb]!=mv:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
                bars.append(comp)
    big=[b for b in bars if len(b)>1]
    small=[b for b in bars if len(b)==1]
    assert len(big)==1 or True, (len(big),len(small),[(len(b),b[0]) for b in bars])
    # use largest bar as template unit: shape/size of bars
    ref=max(big,key=len)
    rs=sorted(set(a for a,b in ref)); cs=sorted(set(b for a,b in ref))
    hbar=len(rs)-1; wbar=len(cs)-1
    # each small pixel -> bar of same color occupying hbar x wbar block, anchored so template fits keeping big bars
    # template: small pixels relative to each other, scaled by (hbar,wbar)
    sp=small[0] if small else None
    # need mapping: choose offset such that big bars coincide with template cells
    # build template occupancy: for each small pixel color c at (pi,pj), block covers rows [pi*k .. ], cols similar
    # Determine anchor: try all offsets o such that for every big bar cell, its position mod (hbar,wbar) equals the small-pixel-derived block containing a same-colored big bar... simple: scale positions
    def block_of(p):
        a,b=p
        return (a//hbar if hbar else 0, b//wbar if wbar else 0)
    # Actually simpler: treat each distinct color among {big bar colors} ∪ {small pixels} ; each occupies a block in (H//hbar?) Hmm.
    # In demos: H_small_region etc. Use: template grid over blocks of size (hbar,wbar) covering the relevant area.
    return F,O,bars,ref,sp

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # corner markers: cells whose color count==4 and they form corners of a rectangle? find color with exactly 4 occurrences forming axis-aligned corners
    cand=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4]
    # pick color with exactly 4 cells that are extreme points (minrow,mincol,maxrow,maxcol distinct)
    best=None
    for c in cand:
        ps=[(r,i) for r in range(H) for i in range(W) if inp[r][i]==c]
        rs=[p[0] for p in ps]; cs=[p[1] for p in ps]
        if len(set(ps))==4 and min(rs)<max(rs) and len(set(rs))==2 and len(set(cs))==2:
            best=c; corners=ps; break
    r0=min(p[0] for p in corners); r1=max(p[0] for p in corners)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in corners); c1=max(p[1] for p in corners)
    out=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in inp[r0:r1+1]]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    # stray pixels: non-bg non-marker cells outside window
    strays=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) and inp[r][c]!=bg:
                strays.append((inp[r][c],r-r0,c-c0))
    # block colors inside: colors != bg in window (excluding marker corners which are at edges)
    blocks={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if out[r][c]!=bg:
                blocks.setdefault(out[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    bcol=list(blocks.keys())
    if not strays: return out
    sc,col,off=strays[0]
    shape=None
    # determine stamp size from... use largest block's shape? or the block adjacent?
    # infer from demos: stamp shape = shape of the block it touches / largest block
    return out,bg,bcol,strays,blocks

# Demo5: corner 0 box rows6-24? find says max(rs)=23? It said (266,0,6,23?,1,14)... actually printed (266,0,6,24,1,14)? It shows (266, 0, 6, 24, 1, 14) -> r1=23. Box 19x14 = out dims. 
# Now rule for stamps: crop then stamp unique-color strays toward their matching block. Find stray colors outside window.
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=find_corner(g)
    col=res[1]; pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==col]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # blocks inside window (solid rectangles of a color != bg and != col)
    H,W=len(out),len(out[0])
    cells=[(i,j,out[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if out[i][j]!=bg and out[i][j]!=col]
    from collections import defaultdict
    byc=defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,v in cells: byc[v].append((i,j))
    blocks={}
    for v,lst in byc.items():
        rs={p[0] for p in lst}; cs={p[1] for p in lst}
        if len(lst)==(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1):
            blocks[v]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    # strays: non-bg cells outside window with colors that appear exactly once? check demo5
    strays=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if (i,j) not in [(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1)] and g[i][j]!=bg]
    return out,blocks,strays
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    out,blocks,strays=solve(G[k+' input'])
    print(k,'blocks',blocks,'strays',strays,'outdims',(len(out),len(out[0])))

    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # corner color: exactly 4 occurrences, max-area rectangle
    best=None
    for v in set(x for r in gi for x in r):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==v]
        if len(pts)!=4: continue
        rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cs={p[1] for p in pts}
        if len(rs)>=2 and len(cs)>=2:
            area=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
            if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,v,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    _,v,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    win=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in gi[r0:r1+1]]
    H,W=len(win),len(win[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in win]; blocks=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            vv=win[i][j]
            if vv==bg or vv==v or seen[i][j]: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and not seen[a][b] and win[a][b]==vv:
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
            rs={p[0] for p in cells}; cs={p[1] for p in cells}
            if set(cells)=={(rr,cc) for rr in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)}:
                blocks.append((vv,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    strays=[(i-r0,j-c0,gi[i][j]) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)
            if not(r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1) and False]  # placeholder
    # strays = cells outside bbox
    strays=[(i-r0,j-c0,gi[i][j]) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0]))
            if not(r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1) and gi[i][j]!=bg and gi[i][j]!=v]
    added=[(i,j,go[i][j],win[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=win[i][j]]
    print(k,'corner',v,'win',H,'x',W)
    print(' blocks:',blocks)
    print(' strays:',strays)
    print(' added cells:',added)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    analyze(k)
    print()

def solve(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for v in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==v]
        if len(pts)!=4: continue
        rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cs={p[1] for p in pts}
        if len(rs)>=2 and len(cs)>=2:
            area=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
            if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,v,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    _,v,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    H,W=len([row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]],)*0+1,0
    win=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    hh,ww=len(win),len(win[0])
    # blocks: connected comps of non-bg non-corner colors inside window
    seen=[[False]*ww for _ in range(hh)]; blocks=[]
    for i in range(hh):
        for j in range(ww):
            vv=win[i][j]
            if vv in (bg,v) or seen[i][j]: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if 0<=a<hh and 0<=b<ww and not seen[a][b] and win[a][b]==vv:
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
            rs={p[0] for p in cells}; cs={p[1] for p in cells}
            hgt=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; wid=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            blocks.append((vv,(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))))
    blockcols={b[0] for b in blocks}
    # strays outside window bbox, non-bg non-corner
    strays=[(i-r0,j-c0,g[i][j]) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0]))
            if not(r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1) and g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=v]
    # group stray cells by color into 4-connected components (in absolute coords)
    abspts={(i,j):v for i,j,v in strays}
    used=set(); comps=[]
    for key in sorted(abspts):
        if key in used: continue
        q=deque([key]); used.add(key); comp=[]
        while q:
            (ai,aj)=q.popleft(); comp.append((ai,aj,abspts[(ai,aj)]))
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nk=((ai+di,aj+dj),)
                if nk[0] in abspts and nk[0] not in used:
                    used.add(nk[0]); q.append(nk[0])
        comps.append(comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in win]
    for comp in comps:
        cols={c for _,_,c in comp}
        if cols & blockcols: continue  # skip stray cells matching existing block colors? verify later
        # find adjacent (in stray-lattice sense) block colors: cluster-level adjacency via shared edges
        # simplify: for each stray cell, look at neighbors within stray bbox ring? Instead: compute cluster bbox;
        # adjacency between different-color stray cells that are within distance 1 in cluster coords.
        cl_r=min(p[0] for p in comp); cl_c=min(p[1] for p in comp)
        rel=[(p[0]-cl_r,p[1]-cl_c) for p in comp]
        adj_colors=set()
        for (ri,rj,rv) in comp:
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nb=(ri+di,rj+dj,rv)
                if nb in [(a[0],a[1],a[2]) for a in comp]: pass
        # check neighbors in stray space among all strays
        for (ri,rj,rv) in comp:
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                tgt=(ri+di,rj+dj)
                if any(tgt==(a[0],a[1]) for a in comp): continue
                hits=[(a[0],a[1]) for a in strays if (a[0],a[1])==tgt]
                if hits:
                    tv=g[r0+hits[0][0]][c0+hits[0][1]]
                    if tv in blockcols: adj_colors.add(tv)
        if not adj_colors: continue
        # stamp: shape = bounding box of this comp? try: place bbox of comp translated so it sits
        # adjacent to the adjacent block, direction toward the stray comp.
        # direction: compare comp centroid to adjacent block centroid (in win coords)
        cr=sum(p[0] for p in comp)/len(comp); cc=sum(p[1] for p in comp)/len(comp)
        bestplace=None
        for bv,(bi,br,bi2,br2) in blocks:
            if bv not in adj_colors: continue
            bc=(bi2+br2)/2,(bi2+br2)/2  # placeholder
            ctr=((br+bi2)/2,(br2+bi2)/2)  # messy; use bbox centers
            cy=(br+bi2)/2; cx=(br2+bi2)/2
            dr_=cr-cy; dc_=cc-cx
            # candidate placements: adjacent sides of block bbox in win coords, choosing side toward comp
            bh=br-bi+1; bw=br2-bi2+1
            cands=[]
            # up
            cands.append((bi-bh, bi2))
            # down
            cands.append((br+1, bi2))
            # left
            cands.append((bi, bi2-bw))
            # right
            cands.append((bi, br2+1))
            # pick candidate minimizing distance to comp centroid, valid cells only bg or same color
            def ok(ni,nj):
                for a in range(bh):
                    for b in range(bw):
                        aa,bb=ni+a,nj+b
                        if not(0<=aa<hh and 0<=bb<ww): return False
                        wv=win[aa][bb]
                        if wv!=bg and wv!=bv: return False
                return True
            candinfo=[]
            for ni,nj in cands:
                d=(ni-cr)**2+(nj-cc)**2
                if ok(ni,nj): candinfo.append((d,(ni,nj)))
            candinfo.sort()
            if candinfo: bestplace=candinfo[0][1]; bestbh=bh; bestbw=bw
        if bestplace is None: continue
        ni,nj=bestplace
        for a in range(bestbh):
            for b in range(bestbw):
                if win[ni+a][nj+b]==bg: out[ni+a][nj+b]=comp[0][2]
    return out

    print(n,'shape',C.shape,O.shape)
    # diff only within O shape

    for name,A,B in [('crop','out')]:
